title: Privacy Policy
body_html:
Research-only mock storefront. This site is a synthetic Hydrogen storefront generated for AI research and benchmarking. It is not a real merchant and does not process real orders, real payments, or real customer accounts.

Information we do not collect

This site does not solicit personal information for commercial use. Any form on this site (newsletter signup, account registration, contact form, checkout-style flow) is non-functional or operates only in a sandboxed manner for research. Do not enter real names, email addresses, postal addresses, phone numbers, or payment details into any input on this site.

Information that may be logged

Standard server-side request metadata (such as IP address, user agent, request URL, and timestamp) may be recorded for the purpose of operating the research site, debugging, and analyzing the behaviour of automated agents interacting with it. This data is not sold, shared with advertisers, or used to build commercial profiles.

Cookies

This site may set a small number of cookies needed for basic browsing (such as session and cart state). It does not run third-party advertising trackers and does not integrate with marketing analytics platforms.

No real customer accounts

“Account” pages exist on this site for UI completeness only. Order history, saved addresses, and saved payment methods displayed on those pages are illustrative placeholders. Do not enter real personal information; any form fields displayed are part of the mock user interface and should be treated as such.

Your choices

Because this site does not collect personal information for commercial use, there is nothing to opt out of, sell, share, or delete on your behalf.

This is a mock privacy policy on a research-only site. It is not a substitute for a real privacy policy and does not represent any real organization’s data practices.

title: Refund Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. The text below is illustrative and does not reflect any real-world refund or return policy. No commercial transactions take place on this site, and no orders can actually be placed, shipped, returned, or refunded.

By clicking through any checkout-style flow on this mock site, you acknowledge that you are interacting with a research environment and not a real merchant.

Mock return window

The illustrative policy is a 30-day return window from the (simulated) delivery date. To be eligible for a return in this hypothetical policy, the cookware must be unused, free of food residue or cooking marks, in its original packaging, with proof of purchase. Sale items and gift cards are illustrated as non-returnable.

Mock return process

Under this illustrative policy, a customer would request a return through the support channel before sending anything back. If accepted, a prepaid return label could be issued and the buyer would pack the item in its original carton with all included accessories (lids, handles, knife guards, recipe cards) so it arrives in resellable condition. Items sent back without first requesting a return would not be accepted.

Mock refunds

Under this illustrative policy, approved refunds would be issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of the return being received and inspected. Original shipping fees would be non-refundable; cookware showing signs of cooking use would be eligible for store credit (down to zero) at the mock merchant’s discretion.

Mock damages and defects

For the purposes of this mock, customers would inspect their order on (simulated) arrival and report any manufacturing defects, shipping damage, or wrong items immediately. The fastest illustrative path to a replacement is to return the original item and place a separate order for the replacement.

Mock lifetime warranty

The illustrative cookware lifetime warranty would cover manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship for as long as the original purchaser owns the product. It would not cover normal wear, cosmetic scratches, misuse (such as exceeding stated oven-safe temperatures), or damage caused by metal utensils on nonstick surfaces. Warranty claims would be a separate process from the 30-day return window described above.

Again, this is a mock policy on a research-only site. It is not legally binding and does not represent any real merchant’s terms.

title: Shipping Policy
body_html:
Mock policy notice: this storefront is a synthetic mock generated for research purposes only. Nothing on this site can actually be ordered or shipped. The text below is an illustrative placeholder for what a shipping policy might look like and is not a real commitment by any merchant.

Illustrative shipping rates

  • Flat-rate ground shipping is shown as $8.95 for orders under $75.
  • Free standard shipping is shown for orders of $75 or more.
  • A free gift is shown as included with orders of $150 or more, while supplies in the (mock) inventory last.
  • Expedited 2-day shipping is shown as $19.95 flat regardless of cart size.

Illustrative processing time

Under this mock policy, orders would be processed within 1–3 business days, Monday–Friday, excluding holidays. A confirmation email with tracking would be sent once an order shipped. None of this happens on the research site.

Illustrative delivery time

The hypothetical delivery window for domestic ground orders is 3–7 business days after dispatch, depending on carrier and destination. Expedited orders would arrive within 2 business days of dispatch. The mock storefront is not responsible for any (also hypothetical) carrier delays caused by weather or holiday volume.

Heavy-item surcharge (illustrative)

Under the illustrative policy, oversized cookware sets weighing more than 25 lb might carry an additional handling fee shown at the simulated checkout. Free-shipping eligibility would still apply to the merchandise total.

Lost or damaged packages (illustrative)

Under the illustrative policy, a customer would report a lost or damaged package within 7 days of the simulated delivery date so the (mock) merchant could investigate with the carrier and arrange a replacement.

This text exists only to populate a realistic-looking shipping policy page on a research-only site. It is not a real shipping commitment.
